prBodyNotes: Upstream release: https://github.com/rabbitmq/cluster-operator/releases. The `Refresh CRD` workflow regenerates `templates/crd/rabbitmqclusters.rabbitmq.com.yaml` from the pinned version automatically, so nothing else is manual. To publish, label the PR `bump:patch` and merge: the tag action derives the next chart version from the existing `v*` tags and dispatches `Publish Helm Chart`.
